feeds.title: Chant du Départ
feeds.description: Chant du Départ is established in 2012. Read the musings & rants of 3 retired militaries (2 USAF, 1 USN), 1 former WSO, and 1 AF brat. Old AF Sarge, Juvat, Tuna, LUSH, and Beans.

feeds.title: Mental Health Cop
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Michael. Welcome to my award-winning BLOG on policing, mental health and criminal justice. I've run this site for the last ten years and it's been used way more than two and a half million times around the world. Perhaps more importantly, it got me a job working full-time on the issues I've written about and a chance to influence the laws, policies and policing across the United Kingdom and the chance to work abroad, representing the UK to other countries

feeds.title: Improving Police Blog
feeds.description: Blog author David C. Couper is a veteran police chief committed to improving police leadership, trust, effectiveness, and officer safety. He writes in-depth analyses focusing on leadership, organizational transformation, community-oriented policing, training, selection, uses of force, and control of crowds.

feeds.title: Scott Silverii
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Dr Scott Silverii. I do my best to love people the way God loves me. I'm a retired Chief of Police with a PhD in Cultural Anthropology, who now ministers to men struggling with trauma from past personal pain, abuse and addictions.

feeds.title: A COP'S WATCH
feeds.description: A Cop's Watch talks about Police Work, Politics and World Affairs, Football and the ongoing search for great Scotch Whiskey!

feeds.title: srj641
feeds.description: I retired after a 27 year career with the Missouri State Highway Patrol, where I attained the rank of Major before retiring a Captain in 2000. I then went to work for the Missouri Gaming Commission as the Director of Enforcement, Chief Deputy Director and served a short time as the Acting Executive Director before retiring yet again!

feeds.title: Chris Grollnek Active Shooter Expert
feeds.description: For over 29 years, security expert and law enforcement professional Chris Grollnek has been immersed in the study and application of protective measures in the military, police, and private sectors.

feeds.title: Lee Lofland
feeds.description: Lee Lofland provides in-depth details about crime, police procedures, & the tools used in investigations to help you develop better scenes and characters.

feeds.title: Sheriff Carter's Newsletter
feeds.description: Lee Country, North Carolina sheriff Tracy Carter blogs about current police issues and how the community can help. The posts are good examples of police/community relations and current law enforcement issues faced around the country.

feeds.title: e-Roll Call Magazine
feeds.description: Mark Bond worked in law enforcement and has been a firearms trainer for more than 30 years. His law enforcement experience includes the military, local, state, and federal levels as a police officer and criminal investigator.

feeds.title: Square Cop In A Round World
feeds.description: I'm Lisa Boeving-Learned, Sergeant (retired). We'll talk about issues relating to policing and the communities we serve. This is a no hate zone, but we may ruffle some feathers. My guiding principle is that integrity is the most important quality a police officer can have. The job is dangerous, but that does not change the need to serve the citizens that place their trust in us every day.

feeds.title: Through an Old Cop's Eyes
feeds.description: I spent 31 years wearing a badge; most of that time with the Mansfield, Ohio Police Department. I've always been interested in creative writing, and now that I'm retired I'm pursuing that interest in the form of fictional crime thrillers set in real locations.

feeds.title: Joe Giacalone
feeds.description: Joseph L. Giacalone is a retired NYPD Sergeant SDS (Supervisor Detective Squad) and internationally recognized expert. He has an extensive background in criminal investigations. He has held many prestigious positions in the NYPD. I'm a frequent guest on television, in print, on the radio, and online media providing expert opinions on law enforcement matters.

feeds.title: Police Mental Health
feeds.description: Mental Health for Cops by Jeff Shannon. This web site is exclusively for the purpose of education. It is not intended to render psychotherapy or be a replacement for counseling or psychotherapy.

feeds.title: The Boogie Man Is My Friend
feeds.description: I am a 40-something female: former police officer. Now working in academia, going back to college, and raising my daughter. I'm trying to adjust to civilian life.

feeds.title: Police Officer Safety
feeds.description: I spent 22 years in the military and joined the Honolulu Police Department at the age of 49.. This is a blog to promote Police Officer safety. Our goal is to help each officer make it home everyday.

feeds.title: Walking the Social Media Beat
feeds.description: Tim Burrows was a sworn police officer for 25 years with experience in front line operations, primary response, traffic, detective operations and supervision. He is regarded as a world leader in the use of Social Media for police and law enforcementNo More Bullies use.

feeds.title: The Director's Desk
feeds.description: I'm the public safety director in Lincoln (population 258,000). I became a police officer here in 1974, and except for a seven year detour to the Sheriff's Office, this is where I've been. I was the police chief from 1994 to 2011, when I assumed management responsibility for police, fire, and 911

feeds.title: RIDING in the SQUAD with CHRIST
feeds.description: Explore police cases and investigations from a religious perspective. RIDING in the SQUAD with CHRIST showcases the thoughts and experiences of a law enforcement officer tackling the meanings of faith, the job, the tools, and whatever catches his attention.

feeds.title: Kristen Ziman
feeds.description: I'm Chief Kristen Ziman. Since I was a kid, all I ever wanted to be was a police officer. I became a Cadet at age 17 and retired as the police Chief at 47. Now I've hung up my badge so I can create even more of an impact. I'm committed to sharing the lessons I've learned and wisdom I've gained during my 30 years in law enforcement to change the culture of policing, prevent mass shootings and cultivate leadership in our communities and organizations.

feeds.title: Raindogblue
feeds.description: Thoughts and poetry from a cop.
